_comment: What each coach operator says about travelling with a wheelchair: in its own terms, from its own pages, each with the page and the date it was checked. Shown under a stop's access details where coaches call, and in the Bus tab for a coach (app.js). Local buses are not here: nothing is said about them that a source on this file does not say. Checked 6 November 2026 at the maintainer's request (accessibility information front and centre).

NATX.name: National Express
NATX.summary: Every coach has a wheelchair lift at the front door. Booking is advised but not essential; if you will move from your wheelchair to a coach seat, book at least 36 hours ahead.
NATX.contact: Assisted Travel Team: 03717 81 81 81, 8am to 6pm, every day

FLIX.name: FlixBus
FLIX.summary: Wheelchairs and walking aids travel free. FlixBus recommends its contact form at least 36 hours before departure to be sure of space; you may still travel without it, but the space may be taken.
